$comment: The reviewed exceptions to the 7-day release age that pnpm-workspace.yaml makes (self-host-install: Release pipeline integrity; decisions-from-groups-15-28, D55 (86); release-age-maintainer-exception). A reviewed pull request with the release-age-exception label may take, before it is 7 days old, exactly the version an advisory names as fixed, when the image scan reports a fixable HIGH or CRITICAL finding in Node's binary or in an npm package, or exactly the version of an npm package that a maintainer's recorded answer calls for, once a supply-chain review of it comes out clean. It adds "<package>@<version>" to minimumReleaseAgeExclude in pnpm-workspace.yaml and records the exception here, with the package, the version, the label and the day the version turns 7 days old (agedOn), and with the advisory, or, in its place, the answer (its day and recordedIn) and the review (its day, recordedIn, compared, provenance, scripts and dependencies); after agedOn, pnpm check:workflows fails until the exclusion and its record are removed. The list holds exactly the exceptions in force, and the release notes list them. CONTRIBUTING.md says how.
